tasks.description: Create UserModel SQLAlchemy 2.x ORM for tbl_user_master. Columns: id (PK), username (String(100) UNIQUE NOT NULL), password_hash (String(255) NOT NULL), role (Enum STAFF/VERIFIER/SUPERVISOR NOT NULL), is_active (Boolean DEFAULT True NOT NULL), created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ via TimestampMixin per DS-014). Index ix_user_master_username on username. Inherits Base + TimestampMixin.

Pure domain functions for auth: get_password_hash (bcrypt via passlib CryptContext), verify_password (constant-time compare), create_access_token (HS256 JWT via python-jose, default 8h TTL per DS-018, reads SECRET_KEY from config), decode_access_token (returns payload dict or None â€” never raises). No SQLAlchemy, no I/O. Fully unit-testable in isolation.

Pydantic v2 schemas for auth + user management: LoginRequest (username, password min_length=1), TokenResponse (access_token, token_type Literal['bearer'], role), UserCreate (username 1..100 chars, password min_length=8, role Literal STAFF/VERIFIER/SUPERVISOR), UserRead (id, username, role, is_active; from_attributes=True), UserUpdate (is_active/role/new_password all Optional â€” partial PATCH). Pure Pydantic; no project imports.

UserRepository extending BaseRepository[UserModel]. Adds: get_by_username(username: str) â†’ UserModel | None (case-sensitive SELECT WHERE username=:u LIMIT 1), list_active() â†’ list[UserModel] (WHERE is_active=True ORDER BY username ASC). Inherits BaseRepository create/update/get/soft_delete. Same pattern as S1 master repositories.

AuthService with 5 methods: authenticate (lookup â†’ verify_password â†’ TokenResponse; 401 on bad creds or inactive), get_current_user (decode JWT â†’ DB fetch; 401 on invalid/expired), create_user (uniqueness check â†’ hash â†’ persist; 409 on dup), list_users (active only ordered by username), update_user (fetch â†’ apply role/is_active/new_password patches; 404 if missing). All DB access via UserRepository; password ops via domain.auth.

Auth router (prefix='/auth', tags=['auth']). POST /auth/login â€” open endpoint, no Bearer required, delegates to AuthService.authenticate(), returns TokenResponse (200 or 401). GET /auth/me â€” requires valid Bearer via Depends(get_current_user), returns UserRead for the authenticated user (401 if token invalid/expired).

tasks.description: Alembic migration for all 5 V2 tables: tbl_user_master, tbl_price_master (with UNIQUE on design_id+grade_id+effective_from), tbl_invoice_header (UNIQUE sales_header_id â€” one invoice per sale), tbl_invoice_line (UNIQUE sales_line_id), tbl_payment. upgrade() creates all 5 + indexes. downgrade() drops in reverse FK order. Per DS-009 ORM-first policy: migration autogenerated from Base.metadata, with manual CHECK constraints added where autogenerate misses them.

side_effects: Creates 5 new tables in the database

tasks.description: Idempotent one-shot script to insert default SUPERVISOR (admin/admin123). Checks if username='admin' exists via UserRepository; no-ops with print if so. If not found: inserts with get_password_hash('admin123'), role='SUPERVISOR', is_active=True. Prints warning to stderr: 'CHANGE ADMIN PASSWORD ON FIRST LOGIN'. Run once after alembic upgrade head on a fresh DB.

side_effects: Inserts tbl_user_master row if admin does not exist

tasks.description: Pydantic v2 schemas for the Inward Report dual-pane response: InwardConsolidationRow (design_id, design_name, size, grade_id, grade_code, total_nos), InwardTransactionRow (purchase_date, supplier_id, supplier_name, place, design_id, design_name, size, grade_id, grade_code, nos), InwardReportResponse (consolidation: list + transactions: list). Mirrors SalesReportResponse pattern. Pure Pydantic; no project imports.

InwardReportService.generate(date_from, date_to, supplier_ids, places, design_ids â€” all optional). Mirrors SalesReportService pattern (DS-017): (1) build shared filter predicate from params; (2) Consolidation query GROUP BY design+grade with SUM(nos); (3) Transactions query per-line; (4) assert sum(transactions.nos)==sum(consolidation.total_nos) before return. Consolidation ORDER BY design_name ASC, grade_code ASC; Transactions ORDER BY purchase_date ASC. Returns InwardReportResponse.

Inward report router (prefix='/reports/inward', tags=['reports']). GET /reports/inward: optional query params date_from, date_to, supplier_ids (list[int]), places (list[str]), design_ids (list[int]) â€” all default None. Pure delegation to InwardReportService.generate(). Returns InwardReportResponse (200; empty lists valid). Auth guard applied globally in main.py â€” no local auth Depends needed.

SQLAlchemy ORM models for all 4 V2 pricing tables: PriceMasterModel (tbl_price_master, UniqueConstraint design_id+grade_id+effective_from, lazy='joined' relationships to TradingDesignModel+GradeModel), InvoiceHeaderModel (tbl_invoice_header, UNIQUE sales_header_id), InvoiceLineModel (tbl_invoice_line, UNIQUE sales_line_id, unit_price snapshotted per DS-022), PaymentModel (tbl_payment). All inherit Base+TimestampMixin.

Three repositories: PriceMasterRepository (get_active_price â€” effective_from<=today ORDER BY DESC LIMIT 1, returns None if no active price; list_all including inactive ordered by design+grade+effective_from), InvoiceRepository (create_with_lines atomic flush; get with joinedload lines+payments; list with optional dealer_id/date/status filters), PaymentRepository (create single payment row). Extends BaseRepository per DS-012.

Pure domain functions for invoice arithmetic: compute_line_total(quantity, unit_price) â†’ Decimal rounded 2dp ROUND_HALF_UP (ValueError if qty<=0 or price<0), compute_invoice_total(line_totals) â†’ Decimal sum 2dp (ValueError if empty), compute_invoice_status(total_amount, paid_amounts) â†’ 'PENDING'|'PARTIAL'|'PAID' (sum==0â†’PENDING, sum>=totalâ†’PAID, else PARTIAL), generate_invoice_number(invoice_date, sales_header_id) â†’ 'INV-{YYYYMMDD}-{id:05d}'. No I/O, no SQLAlchemy.

Pydantic v2 schemas for pricing/invoicing: PriceMasterCreate (design_id, grade_id, unit_price Decimal ge=0, effective_from date), PriceMasterRead (id, design_name, size, grade_code, unit_price, effective_from, is_active; from_attributes=True), PriceMasterUpdate (unit_price/is_active Optional â€” partial PATCH), InvoiceLineRead, PaymentRead, PaymentCreate (amount Decimal gt=0), InvoiceRead (with nested lines+payments; from_attributes=True), InvoiceSummary (header-level only). Pure Pydantic.

PricingService for Price Master CRUD: list_prices() â†’ all rows incl. inactive, create_price(data) â†’ pre-insert uniqueness SELECT to return 409 (not catching IntegrityError); validates design_id + grade_id exist (404 if not); inserts + returns PriceMasterModel. update_price(price_id, data) â†’ fetch â†’ apply unit_price/is_active patches â†’ return (404 if missing). DS-008 soft-delete (is_active=false) â€” no hard delete.

InvoiceService: create_from_sales(sales_header_id) â€” verify exists (404), check no prior invoice (409), fetch sales_lines, per-line get_active_price (unit_price=0 + warning note if None per DS-022), compute_line_total/compute_invoice_total/generate_invoice_number, create_with_lines atomic. list_invoices (filtered summaries). get_invoice (full with lines+payments; 404). record_payment â€” fetch + overpayment guard (422) + PaymentRepository.create + recompute status via compute_invoice_status + update header.

PdfExporter with export_sales_report(data: SalesReportResponse, filters: dict) â†’ BytesIO and export_inward_report(data: InwardReportResponse, filters: dict) â†’ BytesIO. Both use reportlab SimpleDocTemplate+Table per DS-021. Layout: title + generated-at timestamp, filter summary row, 'Consolidation' section + table (Design|Size|Grade|Total Nos), 'Transactions' section + table. Returns BytesIO seeked to 0. Stateless â€” no DB I/O.

ExcelExporter with export_sales_report(data, filters) â†’ BytesIO and export_inward_report(data, filters) â†’ BytesIO. Both use openpyxl per DS-021. Two worksheets per workbook: 'Consolidation' (Design|Size|Grade|Total Nos, bold header, filter summary row 1) and 'Transactions' (Date|Dealer/Supplier|Place|Design|Size|Grade|Nos). Returns BytesIO seeked to 0. Stateless â€” no DB I/O.

ReportExportService: export_sales(format, filters) and export_inward(format, filters). Both: (1) call the appropriate report service to get data; (2) route to PdfExporter or ExcelExporter based on format param; (3) return tuple (BytesIO, content_type, filename). HTTPException 400 if format not in ['pdf','xlsx']. filename = '{report}_report_{YYYY-MM-DD}.{ext}'. content_type = 'application/pdf' or XLSX MIME.

Report export router (prefix='/reports', tags=['export']). GET /reports/sales/export?format=pdf|xlsx&<sales filters> â†’ StreamingResponse. GET /reports/inward/export?format=pdf|xlsx&<inward filters> â†’ StreamingResponse. Both call service.export_sales/export_inward and return StreamingResponse(BytesIO, media_type, headers={'Content-Disposition': 'attachment; filename=...'}).
